nodes.text: A minimal equal-opportunity typed-policy versus result-tree contrast is defensible; its superiority is unverified.
C tests record allocation on synthetic structural tasks, not the complete autonomous research workflow.
C64 repeats 16 tasks; repeated blocks are not new independent tasks and assumed power is not achieved power.
Captured active handoff's ROOT hash differs from captured ROOT; actual active-projection/fresh-context acceptance is not established.
Native session execution, scientific-run ownership and derived research evidence have distinct owners; the C runner is not native ORX integration.
The thesis excludes internal prototype plans and branding; finals-development and reuse constraints remain separate from thesis research.

nodes.choice: Preserve the currently authorized exact-64 study and its frozen primary/replication rules.
nodes.rationale: Avoid interim-result-driven changes and confusion between this review and the separate study approval.
nodes.alternative: Changing the running scorer, budget, task pack, test direction or model is rejected.
nodes.falsifier: A terminal receipt that cannot account for the frozen attempts/identities prevents the corresponding scientific interpretation; never repair it by hiding attempts.
nodes.unresolved_gate: Independent complete receipt review after termination; no extra episodes authorized.
nodes.next_action: Conversation acknowledgement only; do not inspect interim effects to adapt this study.

nodes.choice: Use a genuinely result-aware tree/index with equal evidence and opportunities for any future integrated contrast.
nodes.rationale: Beating a weak allocation rule is not evidence that typed graph control is necessary.
nodes.alternative: A flat indexed append-only evidence log plus an adaptive result tree.
nodes.falsifier: If the strong simpler policy matches utility at lower cost, keep the graph as audit/provenance only.
nodes.unresolved_gate: Pinned policy implementation, matched common substrate and separate run authorization.
nodes.next_action: Propose the single closest comparator after C; no baseline-zoo expansion or implementation in this audit.

nodes.choice: If needed later, separate initial record-allocation benefit from persistent typed-dependency control.
nodes.rationale: An advantageous first record is a mechanism intervention, not proof of every graph capability.
nodes.alternative: Prospectively supply the same first record to both policies as a bounded diagnostic, leaving the primary total-policy contrast distinct.
nodes.falsifier: Loss of advantage under matched evidence allocation limits the persistent-control claim.
nodes.unresolved_gate: New diagnostic protocol and authorization; not an amendment to C and not post-hoc mediator adjustment.
nodes.next_action: Record agreement or disagreement in conversation only.

nodes.choice: Test real next-experiment selection, selective recheck and fresh-context handoff before claiming autonomous R&D efficacy.
nodes.rationale: Structural graph variation alone does not provide scientific domain validity.
nodes.alternative: Retain the narrower synthetic-mechanism thesis claim if an independently scored real workflow cannot be justified.
nodes.falsifier: Failure to distinguish alternative explanations or preserve unaffected decisions defeats the broader workflow claim.
nodes.unresolved_gate: Domain/data contract, independent action gold, fixed opportunity/budget and separate authorization.
nodes.next_action: Specify at most one decision-relevant follow-up proposal after completed C interpretation.

nodes.choice: Later seal one acyclic evidence/handoff revision with scoped invalidation and explicit exclusions.
nodes.rationale: A fresh agent must not combine incompatible ROOT, planning, approval and result revisions.
nodes.alternative: An immutable manifest plus append-only index can meet the contract without a graph database.
nodes.falsifier: A fresh-context consumer accepts a wrong source span, mixed revision, retracted support, or duplicate terminal receipt.
nodes.unresolved_gate: Separate admission and genuine consumer acceptance; JSON/hash checks alone are insufficient.
nodes.next_action: Acknowledge observed mismatch; no canonical repair or runtime patch under this audit.

nodes.choice: Keep paper-only claims, native construction and competition development permissions separate.
nodes.rationale: Scholarly support, product readiness and official event eligibility are different forms of evidence.
nodes.alternative: An internal research/prototype lineage note rather than inclusion of future product plans in the thesis.
nodes.falsifier: Internal branding/future plans enter the manuscript or a prototype is claimed compliant without resolved reuse conditions.
nodes.unresolved_gate: Explicit native restart and any required organizer clarification; no publication/submission authorization.
nodes.next_action: Retain current one-column Quarto edition unchanged and acknowledge the boundary.
